name: Texas Boys State
org: The American Legion, Department of Texas
what_you_do: Spend a week running a pretend city, county and state government. You join one of two practice political parties, run for office, hear speakers and debate.
grades: Just finished 11th grade, with at least one semester of high school left
who_can_apply: Male high school students who finished their junior year. You need at least one semester left. You must never have been to Boys State. School officials must recommend you. You need a parent or guardian's permission. The sponsoring American Legion Post must certify you. You must sign the Texas Boys State Pledge.
pay_detail: American Legion Posts or other community groups often pay the fee, so the cost to the boy is often little to nothing. The fee amount is not stated on the pages read.
duration: One week. The 2026 session ran Sunday June 7 to Friday June 12, 2026.
deadline_text: 2027 dates and the application deadline are not posted on the pages read. The 2026 session ran June 7 to 12, 2026. The site shows an Applications Now Open banner, but it posts no deadline or 2027 dates, so ask your school and local Post.
how_to_apply: A school official nominates you. That can be a principal, teacher, coach or counselor. A local American Legion Post certifies and sponsors you. Ask your counselor or contact your local Post. The program's site is texasboysstate.com.
notes: Boys State is for boys. Girls State is a separate program. The site says the program asks for one or more boys nominated from each accredited public or private high school. Top delegates may be picked for Boys Nation. Confirm the 2027 dates and fee with your local Post.
